span.p:
Validate Dates & Session Target:
- Full Day vs Half Day (N66c: FIRST_HALF / SECOND_HALF)
- Check Duplicate Requests for Dates

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Query Current Balance from Ledger:
SELECT SUM(days) FROM leave_transactions
WHERE tenant_id=:t AND employee_id=:e AND leave_type_id=:l

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Is Leave Type Configured with
allow_negative_balance = true
(Advance Leave)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Reject Submission (BR-LVE-03):
Error 422: Insufficient Leave Balance.
Prompt Employee to Apply for Loss of Pay (LOP)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Route to Supervisor Approval Queue
Status: PENDING_APPROVAL

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Is Category WFH
& within Monthly Quota?
(Q6 / BR-WFH-01)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Auto-Approve WFH Request Immediately
(Skip Supervisor Queue)

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Set Status = REJECTED
Log Rejection Reason
Notify Employee (0 Ledger Impact)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
INSERT INTO leave_transactions:
- transaction_type = 'APPLICATION'
- days = -requested_days (e.g. -1.0 or -0.5)
- running_balance = current_balance - requested_days
- reference_id = leave_request_id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Publish to Attendance Calendar:
- Dates updated to status ON_LEAVE
- If Half-Day (N66c), target session marked LEAVE_COVERED

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Reject Direct Cancellation:
Locked period cannot be mutated.
Must route as Retrospective Arrears in Next Pay Cycle

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Commit Reversal Credit to leave_transactions:
- transaction_type = 'CANCELLATION'
- days = +requested_days
- running_balance = current_balance + requested_days
- reference_id = leave_request_id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Restore Attendance Date(s) to NO_PUNCH / Evaluating
Re-trigger pairing if punches exist

span.p: Pay Run Step 2: Leave & Holiday Freeze
